stories.title: Chinese-owned plant in Pampanga linked to substandard steel bars
stories.summary:
Chinese-owned plant in Pampanga linked to substandard steel bars.

MABALACAT CITY, PAMPANGA, Philippines — Substandard steel products manufactured by a Chinese-owned steel plant in Magalang, Pampanga, may have already been used in buildings and other infrastructure across the country, potentially leaving them vulnerable during future earthquakes, top law enforcement officials warned on Tuesday.

The warning came after authorities raided and shut down Chuangxing Steel.

stories.summary:

MANILA, Philippines — The government will need about a year to fully remove the controversial system loss charge from consumers’ electricity bills, with the Department of Energy (DOE) saying sweeping infrastructure upgrades, regulatory changes and tougher measures against electricity theft must first be completed before the policy can take effect.

Energy Secretary Sharon Garin said.

This development came after Ombudsman investigators filed last July 20 a supplemental complaint-affidavit for plunder, direct bribery, graft.
